name: Acres for America Program
summary: Large grants to land trusts and conservation organisations for permanently protecting habitat through land purchases and perpetual conservation easements across the United States. Two-stage annual round; the 2027 pre-proposal stage has closed.

calls.label: 2027 Request for Proposals
calls.note: Pre-proposals are closed; full proposals, due December 2, 2026, are by invitation only

status.quote: Pre-Proposal Due Date October 19, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

deadline.quote: Pre-Proposal Due Date October 19, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, and educational institutions.

geography.quote: Acres for America is a nationwide program.

access.quote: This Request for Proposals (RFP) will collect pre-proposals from around the nation

window.quote: This program runs annually as a two-phased application.

amount.quote: Individual grant awards are expected to range from $250,000 to $1 million, depending on project scope, conservation value, and readiness.

co_finance_required.quote: All grant awards require a minimum 1:1 match of cash or contributed goods and services.
